implementation_choices.choice: role-specific10/11pt body and130/140/150/160% line spacing with12pt headings
implementation_choices.rationale: table roles need compact stable field comparison; narrative roles need paragraph rhythm. Candidate values are within observed families but not copied as universal rules.

implementation_choices.choice: TD3/TD5/PM4 landscape body; cover remains portrait
implementation_choices.rationale: support long IDs and wide multi-column specifications while retaining original fields and declared layout transition; declared75000HWP wide table allows outer margin/offset within75684HWP body

implementation_choices.choice: safe15/18mm side margins,1mm horizontal cell padding and0.5mm vertical padding
implementation_choices.rationale: exclude extreme exemplar margins and preserve legibility; final native wrapping decides suitability

implementation_choices.choice: Adopt exact reference-used cover font/size/bold by customer/program/title/date/supplier role; OS1 uses explicitly adjacent OS2 cover and PM1 retains partial cadence mapping.
implementation_choices.rationale: Whole-document editorial review includes the cover; original BatangChe cover preservation alone did not match adopted reference typography. Geometry remains fixed, and long supplied program/date labels still need current native review.

implementation_choices.choice: Synchronize only body-section header/footer frame extents to declared page geometry; preserve cover-section frames and all text/IDs/character/paragraph definitions.
implementation_choices.rationale: Historical Hancom12.30.0build6544 TD5 SaveAs changed stale portrait header49324×4252 to landscape75684×2268. The generator must create coherent frames before strict native comparison.

implementation_choices.choice: Apply caption typography only to renderer-registered actual captions; body instructions and source notes retain body typography.
implementation_choices.rationale: A generic 화면/그림/표 prefix can describe business content or an image-location instruction. Caption identity must come from the actual attachment owner registry; a source-specific caption would need separate exact source evidence.

implementation_choices.choice: Discard only declared originally empty suffix paragraphs immediately before a new body section; preserve all preceding visible text geometry and every semantic control.
implementation_choices.rationale: A new section already supplies the page transition. Empty trailing flow can create a portrait header-only page. Source-exact guards and pure-empty/control-free validation prevent deleting a meaningful spacer owner.

implementation_choices.choice: Preserve body value typography/keeps when a paragraph merely carries a T/C/F context key; genuine key headings require explicit renderer registration.
implementation_choices.rationale: Previous prefix inference made PM4 context values bold and keepWithNext despite the renderer declaring them body text. Removing that inference preserves the intended role.

implementation_choices.choice: Start the body section at the exact source report title, preserving source-owned title/period/progress intro typography and all controls; normal-weight work/risk values; reserve enough risk-ID width.
implementation_choices.rationale: Actual r01 original-page findings PM1-SUMMARY-ONLY-PAGE/PM1-BODY-BOLD/PM1-RISK-ID-WRAP; source facts, types, original numeric values/notes and existing controls stay separate from editorial choices. No point-size or line-spacing reduction. The former pre-table p31 spacer is now part of the declared source intro bridge and is preserved instead of discarded at the old section boundary.

implementation_choices.choice: Discard only exact source-empty p25 immediately before source-bound report title when creating PM1 body section. Preserve p23/p24, title/source pageHiding, cover typography and all other owners.
implementation_choices.rationale: Actual Hancom12.30.0 build6544 r04 native section0 p25 has vertpos0 after p23/p24 at62991/64591; current original PNG physical2 is wholly blank and body starts physical3. Explicit title pageBreak and resolved pageBreakBefore are0, so the source-empty old-section suffix, followed by intentional section transition, causes the blank page.

implementation_choices.choice: Declare BREAK_WORD on the exact source-owned cover program paragraph across all19 roles; skip derivation for already matching original definitions.
implementation_choices.rationale: Bounded Mac12.30.0 controlled probe recovers whole-word wrapping without changing supplied text/font/geometry; enum spelling alone is not a universal semantic rule.
